bullets.text: PSTN Switchoff Milestone Achieved – Openreach closes its first exchange, marking a significant shift to digital full fibre infrastructure.
Motorway 5G Upgrades Announced – **VMO2** enhances 4G and 5G coverage across 600 miles of UK motorways.
UK Undersea Networks Secured – The government vows to protect critical undersea infrastructure amid rising geopolitical threats.
AI in Telecoms Gaining Momentum – A new challenge invites telecom operators to leverage AI for network fault detection.
Private 5G Simplified – Moso Networks claims plug-and-play private 5G solutions are now a reality for enterprises.
AI Transformation Essential for Telcos – Industry experts warn of potential extinction for telecoms not adopting AI technologies.
New Subsea Cable Enhances Connectivity – Google announces TalayLink, a subsea cable to improve internet traffic between Australia and Thailand.
World Communication Awards 2025 Shortlist Revealed – The awards celebrate innovation and excellence in the global telecom industry.
Telefónica Plans Job Cuts – The company considers axing up to 5,000 jobs in Spain as part of efficiency measures.
MSSA Recommends NTN Integration – The Mobile Satellite Services Association calls for fast-tracking non-terrestrial network interoperability.
